summary: Enhanced worker prompts across cli-worker.ts and worker-context.ts. In buildCliWorkerPrompt: added role preamble before GOAL, TIME BUDGET section after task ID/dependencies (using step.durationMinutes with min(120, 2x) timeout calc), and VERIFICATION section before RESULT PROTOCOL. Fixed Codex gap in buildCliArgs by prepending WORKER_CONTEXT to the prompt string for Codex workers (since Codex lacks --append-system-prompt). In worker-context.ts: replaced the ralph wall-of-text with a structured decision tree (DO/DO NOT bullet lists plus good/bad examples), and added commit-after-each-logical-unit guidance to the Git section. pnpm build, pnpm lint (0 errors), and pnpm vitest run src/goal/ (421 passed) all pass.
